33:t_1:4.en:
$$カヲル$$
「But many elements remain unstable. Perhaps you and I will once again...」

33:t_1:11.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「The other day's battle was an exception.」

33:t_1:12.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「I will not authorize deploying the EVAs to $c. I have already informed Director $$大塚$$ at the Far East Branch.」

33:t_1:14.en:
$$ミサト$$
「But, Commander $$碇$$... Now that the $$新地球皇国$$ controls most of the world, we cannot know when they will target Japan.」

33:t_1:15.en:
$$ミサト$$
「Wouldn't joining forces with $c be the wiser course, even if it only reduces the risk a little?」

33:t_1:18.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「There is no need for that, either.」

33:t_1:20.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「...Do you intend to operate the EVA on your own judgment again, as you did before?」

33:t_1:21.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I'll find something I can do without the EVA.」

33:t_1:23.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If you're taking the EVA away from me, Father, then I won't pilot it anymore.」

33:t_1:25.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Then I have no use for you. Get out.」

33:t_1:28.en:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Effective immediately, Unit-01 will be operated using the Dummy Plug.」

33:t_1:34.en:
$$シンジ$$
($$赤木$$, $$甲児$$, and everyone else are fighting, and I...)

33:t_1:35.en:
$$シンジ$$
(I won't rely on Father anymore... I'll find something I can do myself. Otherwise...)

33:t_1:38.en:
$$加持$$
「Sorry. That thing you asked me to look into... I couldn't do it.」

33:t_1:40.en:
$$加持$$
「$$式波・アスカ・ラングレー$$ still cannot receive visitors... Her condition is unknown as well.」

33:t_1:42.en:
$$加持$$
「...Looks like what I said gave you the final push to run away from home.」

33:t_1:44.en:
$$加持$$
「I've already heard about your exchange with Commander $$碇$$.」

33:t_1:45.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Did Miss $$ミサト$$ ask you to come stop me?」

33:t_1:48.en:
$$加持$$
「You made this decision yourself. It's not for anyone else to interfere.」

33:t_1:49.en:
$$加持$$
「I'll wish you well on your journey.」

33:t_1:51.en:
$$加持$$
「Want a ride to $$第２新東京市$$ or the Far East Base in Izu?」

33:t_1:54.en:
$$加持$$
(What are you planning, Commander $$碇$$...? Do you intend to abandon your plan here in this world...?)

33:t_1:59.en:
$$シンジ$$
(People heading to school and work... They all have something to do...)

33:t_1:63.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Where are you going? You haven't been coming to school lately, either.」

33:t_1:64.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Not just you, but $$綾波$$ and $$式波$$ too. Are you in the middle of some operation?」

33:t_1:66.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Aha, I get it. You miss $$第２新東京市$$, don't you?」

33:t_1:68.en:
$$トウジ$$
「But $$アマタ$$ and $$カレン$$ aren't there either, and it sounds like the Volunteer Club's having a rough time.」

33:t_1:69.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Yeah. And on top of that, this $$新地球皇国$$ is throwing its weight around.」

33:t_1:71.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Well... it can't be helped. We only transferred to $$第２新東京市$$ because our school here got wrecked.」

33:t_1:72.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Now that they've fixed the school, coming back here makes sense, I guess.」

33:t_1:73.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Let's make the best of things here, $$シンジ$$. For now, why don't we go straight to school?」

33:t_1:77.en:
$$トウジ$$
「...If you were walking down this road, you were heading for the station, right...?」

33:t_1:78.en:
$$トウジ$$
「Were you going to $$第２新東京市$$?」

33:t_1:82.en:
$$トウジ$$
「We'll tell the class rep and the teacher. Go there and settle things for yourself.」

33:t_1:83.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「...Yeah. I think that's best too.」

33:t_1:84.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Piloting an EVA must be hard in all sorts of ways. I'm sure you have worries we can't understand...」

33:t_1:86.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「But you weren't fighting alone, were you? You had everyone in $c with you.」

33:t_1:87.en:
$$トウジ$$
「That's right. So if something's troubling you, go talk to the big bros and sisters there.」

33:t_1:88.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「Of course, you can lean on us too. We can't give you advice on fighting, though...」

33:t_1:90.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Thank you, $$トウジ$$, $$ケンスケ$$.」

33:t_1:91.en:
$$ケンスケ$$
「When you get there, say hi to everyone in the Volunteer Club for us.」

uncertain: 33:t_1:34: Bare Akagi is Shunsuke Akagi of the fighting team, not Ritsuko; used existing bare token.
33:t_1:82: Kejime rendered settle things for yourself, matching Toji's encouragement to seek the Volunteer Club and resolve Shinji's doubts.
33:t_1:87: Big bros and sisters refers affectionately to older team members, not biological siblings.
